rationale: Manjot's 15+ years building mobile apps across healthcare, fintech, and e-commerce aligns directly with Peter's digital health platform that combines mobile apps with AI-driven clinical diagnostics. Both share deep expertise in Swift, Kotlin, and Java, and their complementary strengths—Manjot's proven ability to scale mobile development across 200+ clients globally and Peter's cutting-edge work in wearable AI and clinical validation—create natural opportunities to explore how Ajath's development capabilities could support Azumio's next generation of health applications.
intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Peter Kuhar — your teams both build consumer-facing mobile health applications at scale, and Peter's AI-powered diagnostics work could benefit from Manjot's proven track record delivering complex iOS and Android solutions across the healthcare vertical.
